slides.headline: Turn files into Markdown instantly
slides.say: One GitHub project, and it lets you convert files and office documents to Markdown.

slides.headline: Handles PDFs, Word, Excel, more
slides.body: Converts office files, images, audio, and web pages to clean Markdown.
slides.say: It turns PDFs, Word docs, spreadsheets, slides, images, even audio into clean Markdown...

slides.headline: 197,978 GitHub stars
slides.body: MIT licence · Written in Python · Since November 2024
slides.say: It has over 190 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the MIT licence.

slides.headline: Runs with your file permissions
slides.body: Image and audio features need internet; sanitize inputs in untrusted settings.
slides.say: Image and audio need the cloud, and it reads files with your permissions, so check inputs...
